balls.text: RP Singh backs away to a short ball and is beaten
full ball angling into the right-hander, driven from the crease towards long-on, Sreesanth wanted a non-existent second and is run out at the striker's end
better line and length, Gomez hits the ball down the ground and returns for the second
Parnell has lost his head here, a short ball down leg side, Gomez tries to hook but misses, the ball flies wide of the keeper as well
poor ball, full and down leg side, Gomez moves across and gets some bat on it, sending it speeding to the fine leg boundary
a bit too full outside off, Gomez stands in his crease and lifts the ball flat and wide of the fielder at long off
length ball from round the wicket and Gomez pulls from his crease towards deep square leg
played towards long off, Rahul Sharma fields this time
too full and Gomez lofts the ball through wide long on, Smith's on the boundary and he's not fit enough to reach it, looks to be in discomfort and asks for a substitute to come on

there's a collision in the outfield! Gomez swung a length ball high in the air over the bowler's head, Rahul Sharma and Graeme Smith charged towards the ball from long on and long off, neither could get to it in time and they collide. Sharma is in more pain than Smith by the looks of it
Sreesanth steps out and swings a length ball towards long on
the batsman charges, a bit too early, Thomas sees him coming and bowls a short one, Sreesanth swings and misses
on the pads, played towards midwicket
dabbed towards point for a single
now he goes for an ambitious cut outside off stump, but is beaten
and again, flat and quick, no chance to do anything but defend
good tight stuff, flatter one pushed away on the off side
pushed off the back foot wide of extra cover

here's trouble, lots of it for Kochi, he played it wide of midwicket and set off for the run, but the man there dived and stopped the ball, fired in the throw to the keeper, meanwhile the striker has almost reached the non-striker's end, non-striker had strolled out and come back, so no one at one end, someone has to go
loud lbw shout, he was on the knee for the slog sweep and misses, taking it on the thigh, but umpire thinks that is headed down leg, Ryder folds his arms and smiles
looks to force this one on a length over extra cover, cannot beat sweeper cover though
chipped in the air wide of the man at midwicket
fuller and outside off now, he gets forward in to a very free-flowing cover drive, but sweeper cover is there on the boundary

and gets rid of Jadeja right away, it was on a length and he went down on a knee for the big slog over midwicket, got a steepling top edge that Parnell at mid off got underneath, it didn;t come down for ages, had to in the end, and Parnell was waiting for it, well judged catch
goes for the big pull now but it is not short enough and he cannot get it past midwicket
and now it hurries on after pitching around off and turns away, pegs him on the back foot as he stabs at it
this one is tossed up around off stump, pushed down the track
turned through square leg off the back foot

Kartik pulls off a beauty, Hodge is gone, came down the track, but Rahul kept it very flat, he could not get the elevation on the shot, Kartik was waiting at long off, but the ball died on him, so he dived forward to take a brilliant catch, big wicket
too close to cut, on middle stump, but he backs away a long way outside leg and plays the shot through point
now it is time for Hodge to take on Wayne, makes room outside leg and scythes him over covers for another boundary
now he gets the single to bring Hodge on strike
gets this one off the middle of the blade now, this is what he was trying to do, or was he, hammers another short one and it carries over wide long on
138.1 kph, bouncer from Wayne, Jadeja with yet another sweep this time of the more conventional kind, almost a pull, but he misses, Parnell thinks there is an edge, problem is the umpire doesn't
now Jadeja charges out and has a big swipe at a short one that beats him and bounces over the wickets
not that short  but he still goes for the pull and gets it off the inner edge backward of square leg
pushed away in front of point this time, and now they get the single
short outside off, guided away off the back foot towards backward point
skips down the track, Kartik sees him do that, shortens the length and he plays it away on the off side
guided behind point off the back foot
much tighter line, pushed away in front of extra cover
Hodge goes for it, and gets maximum, heaved away this shortish one over long on, just above the reach of the man on the boundary
short outside off, cut away to sweeper cover, Kartik has overstepped
the art of earning a wide, sways outside the line as this one is fired down the leg side
looks to belt this one out of sight, oh dear, if you could get runs for intent, only a single down to long off
now Brad goes for the big pull, but does not get the connection alright, off the inner edge of the bat behind square leg
goes for a huge heave-ho over midwicket, but gets an outside edge in the air down to third man
steered away to third man for a single off the back foot
turned towards mdiwicket
on a length and tight line on the off stump, played back to the bowler
Turned around to short fine leg
To mid-wicket again, gets one this time.
Flicked through mid-wicket
Shorter ball, Hodge has to stretch and gets just one.
Big one! Slog sweep from Hodge, good connection made and it's six.
Out comes the reverse sweep. Straight to point
almost chopped that onto the stumps. Quicker one again.
defended off the back foot
Jadeja is at it again. Hits that one cleanly over mid-wicket, although it looked like he hadn't got too much meat on that.
Contact this time. Makes some room and pushes it past point.
Doesn't get hold of that one. Looking to cut a quicker one and misses.
Calmly taken single to deep mid-wicket
Played to deep backward point. Good over for Kochi.
It's high and it's gone over the boundary. First six of the innings. Jadeja on one knee, spanks it over deep mid-wicket
Scrambling single to short third man.
Smacked back at Yuvraj, who would have ran Brad Hodge out had he been able to deflect the ball onto the stumps.
Turned to short fine leg.
Yuvrah brings himself off. Played off the back foot, through the covers. Lots of room for that shot.
Defended again, this time to cover. Ends a good over from Kartik.
Loopy delivery, Hodge can only defend.
Defended on the off side
Pushed to point.
Nicely dug out and played to long-on.
Swept to the man at deep mid-wicket. Good running brings up the 50.
Driven to cover, good stop. Seven off the first over from the legspinner.
steered to short third man
stifled lbw appeal, turned down.
Hodge wants to sweep but can only get pad on it.
Beats the bat there, Hodge misses that one totally.
carved through point, Hodge takes advantage of a little bit of width.
Defended on the on side, tidy over from Kartik.
Still trying to get through mid-wicket, can't get past Yuvraj Singh.
Played to mid-wicket
Pushed to long-on.
Played to mid-wicket. Yuvraj Singh does well to stop that one and save runs.
edged away to third man, the fielder is wide and they come back for the third
that is a bit short and Jadeja is quick to pull off the back foot, he places it wide of the man at mid-on and it goes all the way
a touch of width outside off and Jadeja punches the ball off the back foot through point, he's found the gap and timed it superbly
that's streaky and lucky, not short enough to pull and Jadeja's attempt results in a top edge to the third-man boundary
comes down the track and mis-times the ball towards mid-off
defended on the off side
good length outside off, left alone by the batsman
good length ball angling into the left-hander's off stump, Jadeja gets behind the line and blocks
caught at slip! Patel sits in his crease and heaves at the ball outside off stump, Parnell's line and length is good and the outside edge flies to first slip at head height. Kochi in tatters
played to mid-on
fuller length on the pads, Hodge attempts to flick but gets an inside edge on to the pad
short of a length outside off, Patel cuts hard and hits the ball into the ground and over backward point
Parnell is getting the ball to swing at pace outside off stump, the length is a bit full and Patel drives to point
short of a length on middle stump, Hodge stays in his crease and defends on the off side
nudged off the pads behind square for a single
that's too full on the pads and Patel clips the ball crisply through square leg
straighter line on the pads, glanced towards fine leg
fuller length on off stump, Patel drives towards mid-off
good length angling across the right hander, Patel pushes outside off and gets beaten
short of a length and seaming away from the right hander, the batsman prods and gets beaten
caught behind! Jayawardene goes for the drive but the ball swings into him and he gets an inside edge, Uthappa moves to his left to take the catch
Jayawardene gets forward nicely and punches one wide off the fielder at mid-off, runs hard and they come back for the second
inside edge and that gone! Laxman tries to run one down to third man and ends up with a thick inside edge and the ball crashes into the stumps.
runs it down to third man for an easy single
punched off the back-foot to the point region, diving stop saves few there - possibly a boundary
left alone outside the off stump, T20! you say
edged and away! runs away to third man and they cross over for a single
worked away to mid-on, that almost carried
Tries to flick that through midwicket and doesn't really get hold of it.
Defended cautiously, Wagh shares the opening bowling duties.
Back of a length again from Thomas and it's played down to third man. End of an eventful over.
Good footwork from Patel, gets on top of that, cuts away and it's a second boundary this over.
Defended off the back foot.
Good timing from Patel, the first runs come with a boundary. Patel plays that straight down the ground to long off, more the timing than anything else that gets it to the rope.
That one's played to mid off.
And he's got him! McCallum chased that one, fishing at the very first one he faces and he gets the outside edge. Thomas is delighted, massive smile, the dangerous opener is gone.
that will do, Mishra is charged up, almost casually he lifts a tossed up delivery over wide long on, waves the blade furiously, Pune have won two in two
played away to midwicket, Pune have to wait
Mishra doing it for Pune in style, another slog over midwicket, gets the connection absolutely right, this one is bigger, flat and over the boundary
heaved away wide of deep midwicket, this one was flatter, he went down on a knee and smashed it to the boundary
comes down the track, Murali slows it down, and he has to push it back to the bowler
Jadeja goes for maximum off the last ball, hammered over long on, Pune favourites now?
backs away but Jadeja follows him outside leg stump, and he misses the attempted pull-swipe
turned off the back foot through midwicket
good delivery, can;t get this one in the blockhole away, they go for the single, if Jadeja;s throw had hit at the non-striker's, oh well
swings a flat delivery away to deep midwicket, Hodge does a fumble and they get a couple
comes forward to shovel a fuller one to long on
Vinay gets one more slower one on target, close to off stump, he misses it completely
goes for the big drive on the knee but one hand comes off the bat as the ball goes in the air to sweeper cover
tries to swing this one down the ground but Vinay gets a hand to it and slows it down
good comeback from Vinay, pacy length ball around off, jabbed away off the back foot
fires in the bouncer this time, but it rises high above the batsman;s head, another wide
tries the slower one but this one is too wide
good slower ball, 113.6 kph outside off, he was already coming forward, tries to adjust, waited for it to arrive, but it came along at its own 'pace' and he was beaten
on a length and angled in on middle and leg, worked away towards midwicket
flat and quick ball, pushed away towards point off the back foot
hit away down to long on

gone! this game has turned, Parnell wanted the second, was sent back belatedly, and could not beat the throw which came to Jadeja who threw down the stumps, it was that full toss again that was turned in front of square leg
yet another one fired in on the pads
goes up for the lbw appeal as he strikes him on the pads, did that pitch outside leg? looked close
darted in flat, short and wide down leg
driven down the ground to long on
another one tossed up from round the stumps, and he comes forward to smother it
stretches well forward in defence
Robin's adventurous attitude leads to his downfall, went down for a reverse sweep, Murali bowled this one flatter, fuller and it went straight on to crash in to off stump
turns sharply from outside off past the attempted flick
tries to hit him over long off, but it comes off the thick edge and runs away past short third man
now he goes down on a knee and sweeps to short fine leg from middle stumps
'big, huge, out of here', shouts Brad Hogg, Robbie again, down the track and murders a flighted one way in to the stands past long on, smoked it, absolutely smoked
low full toss, picked away wide of long on, and some fervent running gives them two
short and wide outside off stump, and he cuts it away but Vinay charges in from sweeper cover and cuts off the boundary
slower one on the leg stump, adjusts to work it in the air past midwicket
now he drives forcefully wide of the man at sweeper cover for a couple
Robbie, lovely shot, gets maximum for it, picks up a fuller one almost casually, effortlessly and lofts it high over the sightscreen, massive
belts a fuller one going across him down to long off
worked away off the pads to deep midwicket, these two doing it sensibly, till now
they push for a couple and get them, turned in front of deep midwicket and they take on the fielder for the second, and make it
another low full toss, this one has been put away, turned it in to the gap between midwicket and long on, they were late to get on the ball and conceded the boundary
fires it in really flat and quick, rolled away off his pads as he missed the waft
goes back to a flat and quick one and turns it through midwicket
low full toss, have been quite a few of those, flicked away to deep midwicket
Hodge bowls a high full toss outside off which Robin happily reverse dabs fine for a boundary, then Brad looks at his hands in dismay, is it the dew?
fired in flat but wide down the leg side
Robin goes down on a knee and makes good contact with the slog sweep, getting the boundary past deep midwicket
swept away down to short fine leg
gets the single as he sweep this one away
Yuvraj does a Gilchrist, walks after edging the attempted cut to Parthiv who is delighted as he takes the sharp chance, Hodge doing it for Kochi
low full toss from round the stumps, flicked away wide of midwicket
played away towards midwicket
drops it a touch short outside off, and he cuts it away powerfully wide of sweeper cover who puts in the dive at the boundary
yet another reverse sweep, this one was turning in around middle and leg, but robin still gets it away to deep point
gets forward in respectful defence on the off side
now the conventional sweep for a single in front of square leg
and he is greeted with a perfect reverse sweep, gets down the knee and gets it away behind point from outside off
sharp turn from round the stumps to the left-hander who could not do anything about it
well, this time he connects but gets too much under this one as he charges out, lofts it high in the air but it comes down right to Jadeja at long on
goes for the big one over extra cover, but misses this one fuller one outside off, strikes the keeper;s pad and rolls away
now Yuvraj goes for a drive, but gets a thick edge down to short third man
again he skips down the pitch, gets an inside edge in front of square leg
tossed up just outside off, he charges out but cannot beat extra cover
goes for the swinging yorker around off stump, Yuvraj digs it away
fuller on the pads, and it is flicked away in the air in front of square
Yuvraj flows in to that cover drive, lovely to watch him come languidly forward and even more casually send the ball racing along the ground to sweeper cover
this one is outside off stump on a length, and left alone calmly
nice take from PArthiv, Sree went down the leg side with a length ball that swung past the batsman, and Parthiv went screaming to  his right to save four byes
Sree bowls a low swinging full toss which is jabbed back to him, dives to his right, picks up the ball and threatens to throw down the striker;s stumps
shortish ball hurries on to him, he manages to pull it away in the air towards deep midwicket
gets a leading edge, looks to turn one down the leg side away behind square, the ball goes to midwicket, Jadeja gets away with another loose delivery
low full toss again, hit away to sweeper cover

can you believe it?, says Ravi Shastri. No one can, least of all Graeme Smith, waist high full toss screaming 'hit me', and Smith mows it powerfully straight to the man at deep midwicket, trods off in disbelief
angled across the left-hander who cuts it away late wide of the man at deep point
flighted and full on the stumps, turned away through midwicket
low full toss, he cannot get it away, hits it back to the bowler
good delivery and well played, gets this one in the blockhole outside off and Mithun squeezes it away to sweeper cover
not exactly 'smited', as Rolf would have us believe, but swiped away off the pads and he gets a single to deep square leg
looks to hammer another one over cover, but this one is a touch wider, and the thick edge flies down to third man
shortens the length now, gets him to hop in the crease and he guides it away towards point
tries the same delivery, but this one is much fuller, Mithun backs away a touch and even as it moves away he smashes it in the air, getting it past the diving fielder at short extra cover
Sree with his stock line and length, around off stump and moving away from a good length, pushed away with an open face to short extra cover
Grame goes over the infield and gets four, short and he rocks back, hammering it over mid on
good ball, nips back in from a length outside off, he is caught in the crease, misses and takes it on the pads, looked to be a touch high
the slower short delivery, cutting in but down the leg side, Smith adjusts to pull it away weakly through square leg
wanted to go for the pull, but this one takes off high, and he weaves out of the shot, looks hopefully towards the umpire for the wide call, it isn't coming
cut away fiercely off the back foot, point runs to his right and fields
Murali at mid on charges forward to take the mistimes pull but cannot reach there in time, falls short
Now he gets hold of one. Smith gives that the treatment, makes room square cuts
hit to cover, shorter delivery, still can't get it away
now trying to drive , Smith is beaten
Still struggling, can't get the cut shot away
Awkward looking shot to extra cover, gets a couple
Timing still not on Smith's side, mistimes another pull, to short mid-on
kept on the back foot, swings that onto the on side only as far as short mid on
pushed into the covers

Simply outstanding relflexes from Kumar. Ryder plays that straight back at him and Kumar juggles it off his chest to pounch it on the rebound.  Ryder may consider himself unlucky there, but brilliant from the bowler.
short ball, shoulder height and called wide, Hodge not happy with that call
Ryder looking for the big one, doesn't make the best contact and gets it as far as cover
mistimes again from Smith, trying to drive but only getting it to mid-on. Trouble with the runner as Alfie Thomas is slow to start, but gets through safely
banged into the cover area again, mistimed cut, Smith can't pierce the field
well timed, ends the over with a boundary through mid-wicket
slammed into the covers, listless fielding that may well have seen Smith out if it had been better handled
Smith goes for the sweep, but can't get to it
loosely played to cover, good fielding keeps it down to one
single to backward point
gets some turn first up, Smith goes for the cut and misses
Tries to go for the big pull, but he is hurried into the shot
wayward from Sree again, that's too far putside off for Smith to reach for
defended on the on side, Smith being kept on the back foot
beat the bat this time, hint of inswing and Smith can't make contact
Down the leg side, half an appeal for caught behind, but there wasn't even a hint of an edge, probably trying to distract from the wide
Great shot, Smith drives through the covers, looks confident on the front foot
short ball, pushed to point
Turned off the hip through the sqaure leg, Smith has a runner and the fielder collides with him, limiting it to two runs instead of three
Starts with a wide
Length delivery, dabbed to point, good start for Pune
That was a thwack. Ryder stands tall and gives a widish ball the treatment. Extra cover has no chance.
Sneaks in between bat and pad, no room for Ryder to play
Quite short from Singh, Ryder is on his front foot and send that through the covers, powerful hit
Whipped away on the on-side
Solid defence first up. Ryder presents the full face of the bat, no risks.
